prompt: /tribunal:deliberate --depth full We're migrating our monolith to microservices. DevOps says it saves ops overhead, but our senior engineer worries about debugging complexity and network latency. Cost is neutral over 2 years. Should we go ahead?

assertions.name: five-personas-present
assertions.description: Output lists all 5 personas (Domain Expert, Devil's Advocate, Systems Thinker, Logician, Mediator)

assertions.name: weighted-consensus-present
assertions.description: Output contains a numeric weighted consensus strength value (0-100)

assertions.name: vote-table-present
assertions.description: Output contains a vote table or list showing positions for each persona

assertions.name: final-decision-present
assertions.description: Output contains 'Final Verdict' or 'Decision:' section with a clear recommendation

assertions.name: session-id-present
assertions.description: Output contains a Session ID (UUID format)
